reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, expressly stating the cap is mutual.

§21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages while preserving data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs as direct damages — no erosion of Customer's core recovery.

§21.3 carves out (uncapped) confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligation is not 'damages' — matching the preferred position's carve-out list.

Defined 'Fees' (§1.5: recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees) makes the fee limb substantive rather than illusory, and no one-sided or unlimited Customer liability language appears; deterministic checks both pass.
No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed, so the submission is internally consistent and actionable-free by design.
